messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Report 5 is not generated
parts:
Hi Shashidhar,

The problem seems to be that you are not specifying the seconds in the timestamps format (rmc.formtat.time). When I adjust it to rmc.format.time = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S", it works and I get a pdf report at the end:

You may get a warning along the lines of

In addition: Warning message:
In value[[jj]][ri] <- if (is.factor(xij)) as.vector(xij) else xij :

You can ignore this as it is nothing to be concerned about and I will address it in next GGIR release.

Thanks, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
